findings.message: mada glossed 'rut, frenzy'; MW supports it, but shlokam and sanskritdocuments say 'intoxicated' and vyakhya 'मतवाला'. Only 'pride' is recorded as an alternative.
findings.suggested_fix: 'rut, intoxication, frenzy', or add an alternative 'of an intoxicated elephant' citing shlokam and sanskritdocuments.
